name: io.github.tonyyang0504/alibaba_dropshipping-mcp
description: Alibaba.com Dropshipping / Alibaba Open Platform (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, get_produ

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ALIBABA_DROPSHIPPING_APP_KEY
environmentVariables.description: App Key of your Alibaba.com Open Platform app (https://openapi.alibaba.com/ App Console; admin-reviewed).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ALIBABA_DROPSHIPPING_APP_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: App Secret of the same app; signs every call: uppercase hex HMAC-SHA256 over the API path without '/rest' (e.g. /alibaba/order/get) + the parameters sorted by name as name+value (docId=61). Never sent on the wire.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ALIBABA_DROPSHIPPING_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: access_token from the authorisation-code exchange /auth/token/create (https://openapi.alibaba.com/doc/api.htm#/api?cid=4&path=/auth/token/create). It expires after expires_in seconds; renew it with /auth/token/refresh (a signed call) and update this value — the runtime does not refresh it.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ALIBABA_DROPSHIPPING_SHIP_TO_COUNTRY
environmentVariables.description: Two-letter destination country used for product search and cost prices (shipToCountry / ship_to_country), e.g. US.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ALIBABA_DROPSHIPPING_CURRENCY
environmentVariables.description: ISO 4217 currency for search results and product prices, e.g. USD.
